name: Santa Monica Place
summary: Contemporary open-air mall since 1980 with luxury-brand shops, plus a food court & a movie theater.
demographics: Santa Monica Place attracts an affluent, cosmopolitan demographic with visitors primarily in the 25-54 age range, characterized by above-average household incomes exceeding $100,000 annually. The trade area draws from both the wealthy westside Los Angeles communities including Santa Monica, Brentwood, and Pacific Palisades, as well as domestic and international tourists visiting the beach destination. Shoppers tend to be fashion-forward professionals and families who prioritize quality, brand recognition, and experiential retail, with strong preferences for premium dining options and lifestyle-oriented shopping experiences. The center benefits from both local residents seeking upscale shopping conveniences and tourist traffic drawn to Santa Monica's coastal attractions, creating a diverse but consistently affluent customer base.
description: Santa Monica Place is a premier open-air shopping destination located in the heart of Santa Monica, just blocks from the iconic Santa Monica Pier and Pacific Ocean. This architectural marvel transformed from an enclosed mall into a stunning three-level outdoor lifestyle center, offering visitors a sophisticated blend of fashion, dining, and entertainment with breathtaking ocean views. The center features an impressive collection of nationally recognized retailers and boutiques, complemented by a carefully curated selection of upscale restaurants and eateries ranging from casual dining to fine cuisine. With its prime location on the Third Street Promenade, Santa Monica Place serves as both a shopping destination and a cultural gathering space, where visitors can enjoy Southern California's perfect weather while exploring the latest trends in fashion and lifestyle. The center's modern design, rooftop dining deck, and proximity to the beach create an unparalleled shopping experience that captures the essence of coastal California living.
